actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: seed

facts.text: sorting-v0 is registered with entry point gym_sorting.envs:Sorting_Env, max_episode_steps=2000 and the kwargs max_steps_per_episode=100, render=True, num_boxes=2 and if_vision=False
The action space is a 2-D Box with low [-0.01, -0.01] and high [0.01, 0.01]
The observation space is a Box with shape (8,) and unbounded low -inf and high +inf
With num_boxes=2 the observation concatenates the robot xy, the red box xy and yaw tangent and the blue box xy and yaw tangent
The episode terminates when every red box is in x (0.3, 0.5) and y (0.22, 0.41) and every blue box is in x (0.525, 0.725) and y (0.22, 0.41); with num_boxes=2 those are the red and blue box
The wrapper ends an episode when terminated, the task's early termination or env_step_counter >= max_steps_per_episode - 1 is true
The MuJoCo scene is created with the physics timestep dt=0.001 s
n_substeps defaults to 35 controller steps per environment step
A step passes the action to the Cartesian controller's setSetPoint and executes n_substeps controller steps
The context manager samples six box positions from 3-D Box spaces with x in [0.4, 0.5] or [0.55, 0.65], y in [-0.15, 0.1] and yaw in [-90, 90] degrees
The wrapper's seed method delegates to gym.utils.seeding.np_random and returns the accepted seed

determinism.notes: the fake seeds its own Python generator and its state transitions are deterministic, so one seed repeats a trajectory of the fake; the upstream manager draws box positions from numpy's global generator and GymEnvWrapper.seed sets np_random instead, so a seed does not reproduce the upstream start state

gaps: kinematic 2-D state transitions only: the fake moves the end-effector by the action and pushes a box it touches; it has no forces, contacts, arm joints, gripper, actuator, sensor or noise model, and the upstream MuJoCo scene was not imported or run

the upstream scene integrates MuJoCo at dt=0.001 s for n_substeps=35 per environment step (a 1 ms physics timestep and a 35 ms control period); the fake advances one 35 ms control step per tick and does not integrate the 1 ms physics substeps

the fake draws start positions with Python's random.Random and shuffles them; the upstream manager seeds numpy's global generator once (np.random.seed(42)) and GymEnvWrapper.seed sets np_random instead, so one seed does not give the same start state on the two

the fake interprets the 2-D action as an end-effector displacement, while the wrapper passes it to CartPosQuatImpedenceController.setSetPoint, whose implementation reads a 3-D position and a quaternion; the upstream step does not accept the 2-element action unchanged
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by 35 ms only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
the fake returns lists of Python floats; upstream returns float32 numpy arrays and renders through MuJoCo, which the fake does not
sorting-v0 passes max_steps_per_episode=100 in its registration, not the constructor default 2000; the fake uses the registered value

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last state stays readable
